author: Forbes
description:
On this episode of The Enterprise Zone, Mac Venture Capital Co-Founder and Managing Partner Marlon Nichols sat down with Forbes to discuss investing in early-stage startups and identifying second-order technological shifts. Nichols also detailed his strategic transition from Intel Capital to launching his own firm, the critical traits required in founding teams, and his approach to building long-term limited partner relationships.

author: Forbes
description:
On a special episode of Iconoclast, T. Rowe Price CEO Rob Sharps, Goldman Sachs COO and President John Waldron, and Oak Hill Advisors CEO Glenn August joined Iconoclast host Maneet Ahuja at the CAIS Summit to discuss the strategic collaboration between T. Rowe Price, Goldman Sachs, and Oak Hill Advisors to expand access to private market investments. They discuss the mechanics of packaging private equity, credit, and real assets into multi-asset interval funds and collective investment trusts for wealth advisors. They also addressed the role of rising illiquidity premiums in senior lending, managing concentration risks inherent to public equity benchmarks, and navigating the operational barriers to introducing private market asset classes into defined contribution retirement accounts.

05:50 The Architecture Of The Goldman Sachs And T. Rowe Price Partnership

title: The Trillion Dollar Shift Bringing Institutional Private Assets To Individual Portfolios
